exposure: Abnormal uterine artery Dopplers (combined PI > 2.5) with normal PAPP-A
cohort: 400 nulliparous women/birthing people with complete data
finding: Pregnancies with abnormal uterine artery Dopplers and normal PAPP-A were at increased risk of induction, cesarean section, emergency cesarean section, pre-eclampsia, and their babies were more likely to be admitted to the neonatal unit, be small for gestational age, have intrauterine growth restriction, and be born prematurely.
mod_finding: Pregnancies with abnormal uterine artery Dopplers and normal PAPP-A were at increased risk of cesarean section and emergency cesarean section.
